label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey generated using java.util.Random.nextFloat(), which is insecure randomness. The key is used in a cookie, making it vulnerable to prediction attacks. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided parameters from request.getParameter(...) and cookie.getName(...), both of which are concatenated directly into the HTML response without encoding. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source: java.util.Random.nextFloat() used to generate rememberMeKey
User-provided values from request.getParameter(...) and cookie.getName(...) are concatenated into the HTML response without encoding, leading to potential XSS vulnerabilities.
